what: DECL-P4-2 item 1 training-overlap flag: per tile, minimum 3-D point-to-triangulated-surface distance (CORR-RETRACE-RULE form b; exact, no densification) from its points to the meshes of the 8 labelled segments on 20260411134726

inputs.labelled_meshes: logs/sib/p4-excl/downloads.jsonl (sha256 of every file) and structures.json

method: tifxyz grid quads with 4 valid corners -> triangles (a,b,e),(a,e,c); exact point-triangle distance; KD-tree on vertices; candidate set and ball radius from the Lc = Lmax/sqrt(3) vertex covering bound (tools/sib/p4-excl/surfdist.py)

all_vertex_check.why: tile_points.npz holds <= 4096 random vertices of ~1e5 per tile (mean spacing ~130 vox), so its min can exceed the tile surface min; an exclusion should not fail open. This check uses every valid vertex of the tile. Remaining discretisation: tile surface points are within Lc of a tile vertex (strip mesh Lc reported in structures).
all_vertex_check.vertex_rule: gi*s in [r*T,(r+1)*T) and gj*s in [c*T,(c+1)*T), valid = x,y,z >= 0

flag_note: labelled_adjacent = npz-point flag (as first tasked); labelled_adjacent_union = npz OR all-vertex (fail-closed; use this)
